SEBI warns companies about 'Boss Scam' targeting senior executives

India's securities regulator, SEBI, has issued a warning to listed companies and regulated entities about a 'Boss Scam'. This scam involves fraudsters impersonating CEOs, MDs, and other senior executives to deceive finance employees into transferring funds. The alert aims to prevent financial losses and protect companies from cyber fraud.
